    The radical of a vertex projective #

    For a live point x, rad P(x) = {a ∈ A e_x | e_x a = 0} (radP). Every proper submodule of P(x) lies in it (le_radP), so the inclusion rad P(x) → P(x) is right almost split (isRightAS_radP).
